 Luka Doncic, NBA Ref Have Exchange on Video During Lakers vs. Jazz Halftime Break
 Timothy Rapp Nov 18, 2026 Los Angeles Lakers star Luka Dončić and a referee had something of an odd exchange before halftime during Wednesday night's matchup against the Utah Jazz.
 Earlier in the game, Dončić was called for a technical foul, his third of the season.
